fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.adminWallet} approves program ${data.projectId} for credit redemptions, recorded in ${accounts.programAccessInfo}
${accounts.adminWallet} revokes the approval of program ${data.projectId} for credit redemptions, recorded in ${accounts.programAccessInfo}
${accounts.payer} adds ${data.amount} of credits for ${accounts.userWallet}, paid from ${accounts.payerTokenAta} into vault ${accounts.tokenVault}

${accounts.userWallet} redeems ${data.amount} of ${accounts.tokenMint} from its Coinflow credits, sent from vault ${accounts.tokenVault} to ${accounts.userTokenAta} to spend in this transaction; if that token account is created here, ${accounts.payer} pays for it and becomes its close authority

${accounts.userWallet} ends a credits redemption: tokens in ${accounts.userTokenAta} above its balance before it (${data.amount}) go back to vault ${accounts.tokenVault} as credits, and if that token account was created for the redemption it is closed, its rent going to ${accounts.payer}

docs: The Instructions sysvar (Sysvar1nstructions1111111111111111111111111), which every mainnet burn_credits passes after the listed accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.adminWallet} spends ${data.amount} of the credits of ${accounts.userWallet}, paying that amount from vault ${accounts.tokenVault} to ${accounts.receiverTokenAta}

${accounts.userWallet} redeems Coinflow credits for ${data.spendingCurrencyAmount} of ${accounts.userSpendingMint} in ${accounts.userSpendingCurrencyAta}, using at most ${data.maxCreditsToUse} of credits, swapped from USDC through Orca pool ${accounts.whirlpool}
${accounts.userWallet} ends a credits redemption paid in ${accounts.userSpendingMint}; Coinflow takes back what is left above the balances before it, through Orca pool ${accounts.whirlpool}
${accounts.adminWallet} sets the SOL price kept in ${accounts.solPriceInfo} to ${data.price}
${accounts.adminWallet} withdraws ${data.amount} from the SOL reserve ${accounts.solPriceInfo} to ${accounts.destinationWallet}

display.intent: Withdraw USDC from the SOL vault

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.userWallet} gets ${data.lamportsNeeded} from the SOL reserve ${accounts.solPriceInfo} for this transaction, paid with credits: their USDC moves from ${accounts.usdcVault} to ${accounts.getSolUsdcVault}

${accounts.userWallet} returns the SOL it holds above its balance before getting SOL (${data.solBalBeforeGetSol}) to the SOL reserve ${accounts.solPriceInfo}, and the matching USDC goes back from ${accounts.getSolUsdcVault} to ${accounts.usdcVault} as credits
